headings: Savor the True Flavors of Malabar
Taste the World on Your Plate
Experience a Culinary Excellence at its Finest
Flavors That Inspire Moments That Last
ownSnapshot.text: 1 / 6 Creating a Culinary Symphony for You With an enviable culinary heritage dating back to more than seven decades the Paragon Group has set new benchmarks in the restaurant industry. 2 / 6 Savor the True Flavors of Malabar for you Indulge in our Authentic Cuisine and experience the Rich Culinary Heritage at Paragon 3 / 6 Taste the World on Your Plate with us Discover Multi-Cuisine Delights at Our Restaurant with customized flavors. 4 / 6 Experience a Culinary Excellence at its Finest near you Indulge in a world of flavors and impeccable service - join us and discover why we're the talk of the town. 5 / 6 Flavors That Inspire Moments That Last for You With an enviable culinary heritage dating back to more than seven decades the Paragon Group has set new benchmarks in the restaurant industry. 6 / 6 Discover Our Unique Flavors for You Experience us where every dish is a specialty and every bite a taste of culinary artistry. order online FEEDBACK CONTACT US Chosen Among Highly Recommended Restaurants About Paragon Group Decades of Delivering Delights Established in 1939, Paragon boasts an unmatched heritage in culinary excellence. From classic delicacies of the region to innovative fusions of multinational cuisines, Paragon has been a delectable part of happy memories for families in Kerala and the UAE. The flagship Paragon Restaurant is a true icon of Calicut and the Paragon Restaurant in Dubai is one of the most popular Restaurants in the UAE. Read More Paragon Specials Mutton Varattiyathu Crab Bhoomika Paragon Special Kozhi Porichath Fresh Green Pepper Grilled Fish Reshmi Kabaab Pasta with Mussels Our BRANDS Our Culinary Composer, Sumesh Govind, CEO & Culinary Composer, is the present proprietor of Paragon Group of Restaurants and continues the tradition set by his Grandfather Mr. P. M. Govindan who founded Paragon Restaurant, after he retired from the Railways, and his son Mr P. M. Valsan. Though Mr Govindan was a government official, his passion for food that set him apart. As the CEO of Paragon Group of Restaurants, he has taken the group to new heights and introduced the world to many new flavours. His artistic approach, where he involves himself in every process, has made him a wizard at growing the business and a mad, flavour-genius in the kitchen.
